rows.note: Use this for an internet website, not a physical location.

example.english: I found that recipe on this site.
example.traditional: 我喺呢個網站搵到嗰份食譜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 ni1 go3 mong5 zaam6 wan2 dou2 go2 fan6 sik6 pou2

rows.note: Use 地點 as the all-purpose word for a place or location, including a chosen site.

example.english: We still haven't chosen the site for the wedding.
example.traditional: 我哋仲未揀好婚禮地點。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung6 mei6 gaan2 hou2 fan1 lai5 dei6 dim2

rows.note: Use 位置 when you mean the physical position or exact location of something.

example.english: Can you mark the site of the accident on the map?
example.traditional: 你可唔可以喺地圖上面標出意外嘅位置？
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 dei6 tou4 soeng6 min6 biu1 ceot1 ji3 ngoi6 ge3 wai6 zi3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a construction or development site.

example.english: They'll start building on this site next month.
example.traditional: 呢個地盤下個月就開始起樓。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 pun4 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 hoi1 ci2 hei2 lau4
